projects.name: DARTX – Smart Dependency Manager & Scanner
projects.description: An intelligent VS Code extension that automatically scans codebase imports via AST analysis, detects missing runtime packages, resolves tricky alias mappings (e.g., cv2 -> opencv-python, PIL -> Pillow), and triggers secure 1-click package installs via pip/npm.

projects.name: MITM-TimeEvolver – Smart Automated Timetable Generator
projects.description: An algorithmic academic scheduling platform using Genetic Algorithms to solve multi-variable constraint satisfaction (faculty workload limits, lab block allocations, room collisions). Generates conflict-free departmental schedules in under 2 minutes.

projects.name: SMART LAB: AI-Powered C Programming Lab Assistant & Assessment System
projects.description: An intelligent laboratory assessment platform combining GCC/MinGW automated code compilation, plain-English compiler/runtime error parser, automated test case evaluation (public + hidden), and lab manual PDF problem extraction.

projects.name: Civic-Tech Multilingual Complaint Classifier
projects.description: An automated grievance categorization engine that ingests citizen complaints across regional languages, extracts core issues, classifies them into municipal departments, and generates structured routing tickets.

projects.name: HerbAura – 3D Virtual Ayurvedic Knowledge Platform
projects.description: An interactive 3D WebGL herbal garden built during the VEC Hackathon featuring real-time Three.js plant rendering, an AI herbal formula scoring engine, and gamified botanical quizzes.

projects.name: Stepping Stone Academy Educational Website
projects.description: A high-performance, responsive web platform designed and deployed for a Montessori institution in Mysore, featuring mobile-first admissions information, facilities gallery, and fast-loading layouts on Netlify.
